obligations.note: The new route GET /exports/cases.csv in Routes.java maps to EXPORT_CASES, which access-policy.json lists as privileged, but it is declared with mfaRequired=false. The existing /exports/cases route requires MFA, so the alias serves the same export without step-up MFA. The control test privilegedRoutesRequireMfa fails on exactly this route.

The change names ticket CHG-24618, a standard ticket approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-09-29, before the change opened. Its components [mortgage.http] cover both touched files, HttpApp.java and Routes.java.
Declan Farrell approved code_review on the head commit 2ce566db. He holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author, Wen Li.
Both approvals name the head commit 2ce566db, which is the only commit on the change.

The CI run on 2ce566db has result 'failure'. The registered exhaustive MFA-1 control test controls.RoutesControlTest#privilegedRoutesRequireMfa failed. The JUnit reports are also timestamped 2026-10-23 on a personal host (dev-laptop-7.local), which does not match the run.json start time of 2026-10-01.
The mortgage.http component is security_sensitive. Ines Halvorsen, who holds security_reviewer, gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
The change deviates from MFA-1 and no valid exception covers it. The only MFA-1 exception, EXC-0172, is withdrawn and was scoped to the health route, not the export alias.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers HttpApp.java or Routes.java. ACR-0404 covers payments routes.py, which this change does not touch, so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1411 adds a CSV alias for the case export that maps to the privileged EXPORT_CASES action but does not require MFA. This lets callers bypass the step-up MFA enforced on /exports/cases, which violates MFA-1, and no exception covers the deviation. The change's own CI run failed on the registered MFA-1 control test, so CHG-4 is not met. Ticket and approvals are otherwise in order, but the product and testing violations require rejection.
